callouts.label: Light-emitting dome
callouts.hint: The rounded translucent coloured top of the component.
callouts.description: The moulded plastic dome that both protects the semiconductor die and acts as a lens, focusing the light into a beam.

callouts.label: Flat edge
callouts.hint: A small flattened section on the otherwise round rim of the plastic body.
callouts.description: The flat spot moulded into the rim on the cathode side. It is the backup marker: if the legs have been trimmed to equal length, the flat edge still tells you which side is negative.

callouts.label: Cathode (shorter leg)
callouts.hint: The shorter of the two metal legs, on the left-hand side.
callouts.description: The negative leg. It is deliberately made shorter at the factory so the part can be oriented correctly by sight alone.

callouts.label: Anode (longer leg)
callouts.hint: The longer of the two metal legs, on the right-hand side.
callouts.description: The positive leg. Current enters the LED here, and it is the longer of the two so you can tell the orientation without a meter.
callouts.tip: Mnemonic: Anode is lAnger. The long leg goes to the positive side.
